activity.notes: Following the Austro-Hungarian Compromise, Franz Joseph was crowned King of Hungary in Budapest on 8 June 1867 and remained king until his death in 1916. ATLAS records the Hungarian crown separately from his Austrian imperial title.

sources.title: Franz Joseph I taking the Hungarian coronation oath in 1867 — Austrian Parliament
sources.citation_text: The Austrian Parliament documents Emperor Franz Joseph I taking the Hungarian coronation oath in 1867, supporting the distinct Hungarian royal crown after the Compromise.

sources.title: The Eternal Emperor. Franz Joseph I 1830–1916 — Austrian National Library
sources.citation_text: The Austrian National Library documents Franz Joseph's reign from his 1848 accession until his death in 1916.
